observations: Global summary retains fees.lifetime, pending rewards, PAPER supply/staked, accumulator and original raw economic parameters; current counter-based reward calculations do not depend on a fixed mint-rate assumption.
House current payload contains extra revision and heads metadata; accepted head, source time, trader long/short entries remain compatible.
Account directory includes extra stakingRewards and _leaderboardRank fields; schema intentionally strips unused fields, and missing currentOpenPositionCount remains supported.

Recent events include positionId, intentId, instrumentId and instrumentTerminal in addition to existing fields. All sampled events normalize; provenance/identity semantics would need separate verification before changing ingestion identity.
Source enforces sorted, unique, URLSearchParams-encoded query parameters and specific allowed limits/ranges; production canonicalPath and history paths already comply.
Root confirmed initially old leaderboard responses refresh successfully on a second read; observed behavior is stale-while-revalidate caching, not an upstream contract failure.
limitations: Bounded public samples validate currently returned contracts, not every wallet, unsupported instrument, or missing historical interval. No production storage or source files modified by this audit.
